column1: # catalog/lane-run-secrets.d/fly-pool.tsv: the secrets a lane-run group app
# must hold to run the fly-pool lane on its machines. One reader:
# Tab-separated, 4 fields: name need hub_source note.
#   name        one placeholder at most: <PROJECT> (upper case, . and - as _,
#               the bin/lib/fly-token.sh rule) or <OWNER> (the fleet.conf repo
#   hub_source  <envfile>:<VAR> (a variable in a file in the hub env dir) or
#               file:<envfile> (the text of a file in the hub env dir).
# Values never go in this file.

column4: the pool app Fly token (bin/lib/fly-token.sh; the org FLY_API_TOKEN is the fallback)
the App key PEM text; the entrypoint writes it mode 600
the installation id of the repo owner
